sentences.text: The bank’s documents state a pre-payment charge of 2% of the amount prepaid or principal outstanding. [calc:1]
For Rs 10,00,000 prepaid, the charge would be {{calc:1}}.

The UCB directions say pre-payment charges apply only as stated in paragraph 261, but their applicability to this case is unknown because the required borrower, purpose, rate type, facility, and sanction-date details are not provided in the findings.
